extension_params.data_query:
type:worklist.records
of:addresses
expand:[contact__label]
query:(
  ticket.id:[{{record_id}}]
  sort:email
  limit: 5
)
format:dictionaries
extension_params.sheet_kata:
layout:
  style: table
  headings@bool: no
  paging@bool: yes
  filtering@bool: yes

columns:
  selection/id:
  card/email:
    label: Email
    params:
      image@bool: yes
      bold@bool: yes
      context_key: _context
      label_key: _label
      id_key: id
extension_params.toolbar_kata:
interaction/add:
  label: Add participants
  uri: cerb:automation:cerb.ticket.participants.add
  inputs:
    ticket@key: record_id
  icon: circle-plus
  hidden@bool: 
    {% if row_selections is not empty %}yes{% endif %}
  after:
    refresh_widgets@list:
      Participants

interaction/remove:
  label: Remove {{row_selections|length}} selections
  uri: cerb:automation:cerb.ticket.participants.remove
  inputs:
    ticket@key: record_id 
    participants@key: row_selections 
  icon: circle-remove
  hidden@bool: 
    {% if row_selections is empty %}yes{% endif %}
  after:
    refresh_widgets@list:
      Participants
